desc: As administrative staff, I want to register a new patient's data to enroll them in the system.
ac: The system must request the full name, date of birth, sex, identity document, and contact details (email address and phone number).
The system must display an error if a patient with the entered identity document already exists.
The system must assign a unique patient number to the new patient.

desc: As the system, I want to generate a unique patient number to identify each record.
As administrative staff, I want to edit a registered patient's data to keep the information up to date.
ac: The system must allow modifying the full name, date of birth, sex, identity document, and contact details (email address and phone number).

desc: As administrative staff, I want to register a patient's medical background in their electronic clinical record to understand their health status.
ac: The system must allow entering the patient's blood type.
The system must allow entering chronic diseases, allergies, relevant injuries, and regular medications along with the date they started/occurred, with the option to indicate "from birth".

desc: As administrative staff, I want to search for a patient by their name to access their information.
ac: The system must display a search field that allows entering the name.
The system must display a list of patients whose names match the entered data.

desc: As administrative staff, I want to search for a patient by their identity document to retrieve their record.
ac: The system must display a search field that allows entering the identity document.
The system must display a list of patients whose documents match the entered data.

desc: As administrative staff, I want to search for a patient by their patient number to retrieve their record.
ac: The system must display a search field that allows entering the patient number.
The system must display a list of patients whose patient numbers match the entered data.

desc: As a doctor, I want to search for a patient by their name to consult their clinical record.
ac: The system must display a search field that allows entering the name.
The system must display a list of patients whose names match the entered data.

desc: As a doctor, I want to search for a patient by their identity document to access their clinical record.
ac: The system must display a search field that allows entering the identity document.
The system must display a list of patients whose documents match the entered data.

desc: As a doctor, I want to search for a patient by their patient number to access their clinical record.
ac: The system must have a search field that allows searching by patient number.
The system must display a list of patients whose patient numbers match the entered data.

desc: As administrative staff, I want to view a patient's complete information to consult their personal data.
ac: The system must display the patient's personal data: full name, date of birth, sex, identity document, and contact details (email address and phone number).
The system must display the patient number.

desc: As administrative staff, I want to view a patient's scheduled appointments to consult their information.
ac: The system must display the appointment details: specialty, doctor, schedule, and status.

desc: As administrative staff, I want to register an appointment to schedule a patient's medical care.
ac: The system must allow selecting the specialty and doctor for the appointment.
The system must display the available time slots in the selected doctor's schedule.
The system must display an error if an appointment already exists at that time slot.
The system must change the appointment status to "Confirmed" after a successful registration.

desc: As administrative staff, I want to cancel an existing appointment to free up the time slot in the schedule.
ac: The system must allow changing the appointment status to "Canceled".
The system must make the previous time slot available again in the doctor's schedule.

desc: As administrative staff, I want to edit an existing appointment to change its date without losing the information.
ac: The system must allow editing the date and time of an existing appointment.
The system must validate that the new time slot is available.

desc: As a patient, I want to be notified by email when my appointment is modified so I stay informed.
ac: The system must indicate in the notification if the appointment was canceled.
The system must indicate in the notification if the appointment had a schedule change.
The system must include the new appointment date in the notification when a date change occurs.

desc: As a patient, I want to be notified by text message to my phone number when my appointment is modified so I stay informed.
ac: The system must indicate in the notification if the appointment was canceled.
The system must indicate in the notification if the appointment had a schedule change.
The system must include the new appointment date in the notification when a date change occurs.

desc: As a doctor, I want to access a patient's clinical record to review their prior information.
ac: The system must allow access to the clinical record only to users with the doctor role.
The system must list the diagnoses for each appointment confirmed by the patient.
The system must display the patient's medical background.

desc: As a doctor, I want to register the diagnosis made during the appointment to document the medical care provided.
ac: The system must include the date, name, and specialty of the responsible doctor in each record.
The system must allow marking the appointment as Attended when a diagnosis is registered.
The system must allow marking the appointment as Not attended.
The system must prevent registering a diagnosis when the appointment is marked as Not attended.

desc: As a patient, I want to consult my electronic clinical record to access my medical information.
ac: The system must list all appointments associated with the patient.
The system must list all medications associated with the patient.
The system must list all invoices associated with the patient.
The system must allow sorting the information by date, responsible doctor, or specialty.
The system must allow viewing the details of each listed item.

desc: As administrative staff, I want to register doctors with their respective specialties to enroll them in the system.
ac: The system must allow registering the doctor's full name, identity document number, and contact details (email address and phone number).
The system must allow associating a specialty with the doctor being registered.
The system must allow defining the doctor's status as active or inactive.
The doctor's name and identity document cannot be left empty in the registration.

desc: As administrative staff, I want to define a doctor's attention hours to enable appointment assignment.
ac: The system must allow defining the start time and end time per day of the week.
The system must allow defining more than one time slot per day.
The system must display an error if the time slots for the same day overlap.
The system must display an error if the start times precede the end times.

desc: As administrative staff, I want to edit a registered doctor's data to keep the information up to date.
ac: The system must allow editing the doctor's full name, identity document number, and contact details.

desc: As administrative staff, I want to edit a doctor's attention hours to keep the information up to date.
ac: The system must allow editing the days of the week for attention.
The system must allow editing the start time and end time for a day of the week.
The system must display an error if the time slots for the same day overlap.
The system must display an error if the start times precede the end times.

desc: As administrative staff, I want to deactivate a registered doctor to keep the information up to date.
ac: The system must allow changing the doctor's status to inactive.

desc: As administrative staff, I want to activate a registered doctor to keep the information up to date.
ac: The system must allow changing the doctor's status to active.

desc: As the system, I want to define system roles to organize access to functionalities.
ac: The system must define the following roles: administrative staff, doctor, pharmacist, analyst, and patient.

desc: As the system, I want to associate permissions with each role to control access to system functionalities.
ac: The system must associate functionalities with each role.
The system must display an error if a user accesses a functionality not defined in their role.

desc: As administrative staff, I want to generate an invoice associated with an appointment to have a payment receipt.
ac: The system must include in the invoice the patient's full name, appointment specialty, date, and total cost.
The system must include a unique identifier in the invoice.
The system must associate the invoice with the patient and the appointment.

desc: As the system, I want to generate a unique identifier to identify each invoice.
As a pharmacist, I want to generate an invoice associated with a medication to have a payment receipt.
ac: The system must include in the invoice the patient's full name, medication name, date, and total cost.
The system must include a unique identifier in the invoice.
The system must associate the invoice with the patient and the medication.

desc: As a pharmacist, I want to search for a patient by their identity document to consult the patient's medications.
ac: The system must have a search field that allows searching by identity document.
The system must display a list of results matching the entered data.

desc: As a pharmacist, I want to view a patient's medications to consult their medications.
ac: The system must list the patient's medications.
The system must allow generating the invoice.

desc: As administrative staff, I want to generate an invoice associated with a medication to have a payment receipt.
ac: The system must include in the invoice the patient's full name, medication name, date, and total cost.
The system must include a unique identifier in the invoice.
The system must associate the invoice with the patient and the medication.

desc: As administrative staff, I want to view a patient's medications to consult their medications.
ac: The system must list the patient's medications.
The system must allow generating the invoice.

desc: As a patient, I want to receive an email notification with the invoice attached to access the payment receipt.
ac: The system must send an email to the patient's email address containing: invoice identifier, patient name, date, and service type (appointment or medication).
The system must include in the subject line that it is a hospital invoice.
The system must include the invoice attached in PDF format.
The system must send the email within 10 minutes after the invoice is generated.

desc: As a patient, I want to be notified by text message to my phone number with the invoice information to stay informed about the charge.
ac: The system must send a text message to the patient's phone number containing: invoice identifier, patient name, date, and service type (appointment or medication).
The system must include the total cost of the invoice.
The system must send the text message within 10 minutes after the invoice is generated.

desc: As a pharmacist, I want to register medications to keep the hospital inventory up to date.
ac: The system must register each medication with name, manufacturer, available units, stock number, and expiration date.
The system must display an error if the expiration date is earlier than the current date.
The system must display an error if the stock number is not unique.
The system must display an error if the medication name is left empty.
The system must display an error if the number of available units is less than 0.

desc: As a pharmacist, I want to register supplies to keep the hospital inventory up to date.
ac: The system must register each supply with name, manufacturer, available units, stock number, and expiration date.
The system must display an error if the expiration date is less than or equal to the current date.
The system must display an error if the stock number already exists in the system.
The system must display an error if the supply name is left empty.
The system must display an error if the number of available units is less than 0.

desc: As a pharmacist, I want to edit how many medications are available to keep the hospital inventory up to date.
ac: The system must allow modifying the available units.
The system must display an error if the number of available units is less than 0.

desc: As a pharmacist, I want to edit how many supplies are available to keep the hospital inventory up to date.
ac: The system must allow modifying the available units.
The system must display an error if the number of available units is less than 0.

desc: As a pharmacist, I want to associate a medication with the patient who collected it so the system generates the corresponding invoice.
ac: The system must associate the collected medication with the patient.
The system must allow selecting the quantity to collect.
The system must update the available units according to the collected quantity.
The system must display an error if the collected quantity exceeds the available units.

desc: As a pharmacist, I want to consult the medication inventory sorted by available quantity to quickly identify medications with the lowest or highest stock.
ac: The system must display the medication name and the number of available units.
The system sorts from lowest to highest.

desc: As a pharmacist, I want to consult the medication inventory sorted by expiration date to identify medications about to expire.
ac: The system must display the medication name and the expiration date.
The system sorts from lowest to highest.

desc: As a pharmacist, I want to consult the supply inventory sorted by available quantity to quickly identify supplies with the lowest or highest stock.
ac: The system must display the supply name and the number of available units.
The system sorts from lowest to highest.

desc: As a pharmacist, I want to consult the supply inventory sorted by expiration date to identify supplies about to expire.
ac: The system must display the supply name and the expiration date.
The system sorts from lowest to highest.

desc: As a pharmacist, I want to check how many units of a medication are available to make timely decisions.
ac: The system must display the number of available units of the medication.

desc: As a pharmacist, I want to check how many units of a supply are available to make timely decisions.
ac: The system must display the number of available units of the supply.

desc: As a pharmacist, I want to search for a medication by its name to access its information.
ac: The system must have a search field that allows searching by medication name.
The system must display a list of medications whose names match the entered data.

desc: As a pharmacist, I want to search for a supply by its name to access its information.
ac: The system must have a search field that allows searching by supply name.
The system must display a list of supplies whose names match the entered data.

desc: As a pharmacist, I want to know when a medication is about to expire to make timely decisions.
ac: The system must allow listing all medications and sorting them by expiration date.
The system must display the medication's expiration date.
The system must highlight in red when one month remains before the medication expires.

desc: As a pharmacist, I want to know when a supply is about to expire to make timely decisions.
ac: The system must allow listing all supplies and sorting them by expiration date.
The system must display the supply's expiration date.
The system must highlight in red when one month remains before the supply expires.

desc: As a pharmacist, I want to know when a medication has a low number of available units to make timely decisions.
ac: The system must allow listing all medications and sorting them by available units.
The system must display the number of available units of the medication.
The system must highlight in red when fewer than 10 units remain.

desc: As a pharmacist, I want to know when a supply has a low number of available units to make timely decisions.
ac: The system must allow listing all supplies and sorting them by available units.
The system must display the number of available units of the supply.
The system must highlight in red when fewer than 10 units remain.

desc: As an analyst, I want to view appointment statistics by specialty to evaluate the workload.
ac: The system must list all existing specialties.
The system must allow choosing a specialty.
The system must display the total number of appointments: overall, attended, canceled, confirmed, and not attended.
The system must allow choosing a date range.
The system must display an error if the start date is later than the end date.
The system must display an error if the end date is later than the current date.

desc: As an analyst, I want to view financial reports of the services to evaluate the hospital's income and economic performance.
ac: The system must display the hospital's total income.
The system must display the income by specialty.
The system must display the income by medication.
The system must allow choosing the query date range.
The system must display an error if the start date is later than the end date.
The system must display an error if the end date is later than the current date.

desc: As an analyst, I want to view supply consumption to evaluate the hospital's inventory usage.
ac: The system must allow filtering by name.
The system must list all supplies sorted by consumption (number of units collected).
The system must display the total number of units collected.
The system must allow choosing the query date range.
The system must display an error if the start date is later than the end date.
The system must display an error if the end date is later than the current date.
